Chapter 6501: Flame Of A True Immortal

Chapter 6501: Flame Of A True Immortal

“I don’t care if you’re an immortal, you will die today.” The immortal vessel directed the flame at Li Qiye.

It was contained in a primitive firestarter tube with a badge-like lock sealing the opening. Li Qiye frowned because this looked much like what the skull had given him.

His was larger but didn’t have the badge lock. If he were to hang it, it would look more like a bronze lantern.

“Shit, looks like the brat found it. His master actually left it behind.” The skull inside Gold Village took note of this.

Trinity, Eight-armed, and Nine-turns stared at the tube and became frightened. Skyraiser, in particular, understood the consequences of using it.

Poye had used it before to burn a tree, leaving behind this depleted tube. Nevertheless, the remnant flame could kill an immortal.

They didn’t know why Seventy-two Origin Ancestor had it instead of Supreme Heaven or Weizhen.

Skyraiser had strong ties with Seventy-two but still didn’t know the answer. Nevertheless, this thing had been sealed all this time.

They treated it as their sect’s defining treasure only to be used to save their sect. However, Seventy-two wanted to use it to kill Li Qiye.

The primal ancestors who haven’t seen it in action still knew it could incinerate Old World.

Li Qiye, on the other hand, didn’t care about the flame, only the container itself. He concluded it wasn’t created by Zhan Sansheng but his master.

A nobody such as Seventy-two couldn’t understand the secret and meaning behind this.

“What does he want? To leave this behind.” The skull also paid attention to the tube, not the flame.

He had the other lantern for a long time but couldn’t figure it out. If that person wanted to leave behind an ace card for his disciple, it would have been a direct transfer. The greater possibility was his leaving a piece of information to Li Qiye.

“Damn, I will never believe that you two aren’t conspiring together.” The skull murmured. Intuition told him Li Qiye must be scheming or rather, working with that person.

He took a deep breath after thinking about the possibilities of these two being a team.

“Heavenrealm is one thing, they might even flatten the villainous heaven.” He continued.

In reality, the two had never met before. Of course, this didn’t imply the non-existence of a plan between them. Perhaps they had a plan going on without needing to communicate.

All in all, they were the only ones who had an answer to this question.

“Afraid now? It’s too late to beg.” Seventy-two saw Li Qiye’s serious expression and had the wrong idea.

“Three Immortals’ conditions are just too good, any idiot can become a primal ancestor. Sigh, what a waste of resources.” Li Qiye shook his head disapprovingly.

“You...” Seventy-two nearly vomited from anger: “You won’t be running your mouth anymore once struck by this flame.”

“Let’s pretend your flame can kill an immortal, are you sure you know how to fire?” Li Qiye asked.

The others exchanged glances since they hadn’t thought of this point. Seventy-two and Skyraiser knew the potential devastation so they never tried to open it previously.

“Of course we can, Senior Poye used it before.” Seventy-two shouted, albeit without conviction.

What if he couldn’t open it? Then he would look like a clown after all the threats earlier.
